summary: decide_dependencies tests cover the ordering conjunct (missing dep id gets generic 403 scope denial, not a service-layer existence error), the every-id conjunct (mixed in/out-of-scope list denied in both orders, ruling out a first-id-only check), a nonempty-but-short non-id-shaped string, and the positive governed-descendant-allowed case proving the secondary check uses the same self-or-governed-descendant rule as the primary target.
